text:
elaine: POC with MavenEdge just hit sustained 429s during a stress run. Customer (Casey) reports ~120 req/s and we see bursts that spike errors. Need immediate swarming — they're asking about timeline and whether we can route to Dedicated for the test.

sam: Can you paste the exact error pattern and which endpoint? generation or embeddings?

casey: generation endpoint (/v1/generate). Errors started ~14:02 UTC. We saw a lot of `rate_limit_exceeded` and some `auth_failed` noise.

jordan: Pulling logs now. Any chance they hit a concurrency limit on their API key? Are they using shared key from the eval sandbox?

elaine: They're on trial hosted key from our console (org:maventech). Not Dedicated.

jordan: Found repeated 429s in the gateway logs:```
2026-03-21T14:02:12Z ERROR gateway request_id=aa3f2 rate_limit_exceeded scope=org:maventech rpm=720 burst=150
2026-03-21T14:02:12Z WARN  proxy upstream=runtime-1 latency_ms=2100 tokens=512
```
Looks like token/rate ramping plus a backlog on runtime.

sam: Two paths: 1) quickly increase org throttle for the POC (temporary uplift) 2) route traffic to a Dedicated pool or lower-cost model variant with higher throughput. Which does the customer prefer?

ryan: Customer asked about pricing for Dedicated for a short 72-hour sprint — Casey, can you confirm budget flex?

casey: We can get an internal OK for a short-window burst if you can commit to <24h to stand it up. Need to know cost ballpark and whether it affects output quality.

marta: Security note: if we lift org rate limits, we need a quick sign-off on the temporary key scope. Don't want an open unlimited key — propose whitelist by IP + expiration.

jordan: Agreed. For immediate relief I can create a scoped override for org:maventech limited to 200 req/s and expiry in 24h. Will also pin to model gpt-redwood-3-small for throughput.

elaine: That sounds good. Jordan — do that and post the override ID. Sam — confirm model parity impact with Casey.

sam: gpt-redwood-3-small will drop some long-form coherency vs the medium model but for demo flows it should be fine. Recommend we set max_tokens=256 and eval sample to ensure pass rate.

deploy-bot: [deployment] created rate-limit-override id=OVR-9821 for org:maventech, limit=200rps, expires=2026-03-22T14:02:00Z

jordan: Override in place. I've also routed test traffic to runtime-dedicated-pt1 to avoid contention. Monitoring logs now.

casey: Running the same stress test... still some 429s but far fewer. error_rate down from ~18% to ~2%. Good improvement.

ryan: I'll follow up on Dedicated short-term pricing — estimate ~3k/day for a small reserved pool plus bandwidth, will confirm.

marta: For the security questionnaire follow-up: we'll need a signed temporary change request (email OK) and IP ranges for whitelisting. Casey, can you send the IPs?

casey: Sending IPs now in DM. Also, can you open a formal ticket so our SRE can have a single contact?

elaine: Created ticket INF-8421 and added the customer SRE + our oncall. Jordan, assign to eng-runtime and paste runbook entry.

jordan: Assigned INF-8421 -> eng-runtime. Runbook note: temporary override OVR-9821, routed to runtime-dedicated-pt1, model pinned to gpt-redwood-3-small, monitor for token queue > 500ms.

sam: Next steps for POC handoff: 1) confirm cost and uplift window (Ryan), 2) security sign-off + IPs (Marta/Casey), 3) QA pass on model outputs (Sam/Casey), 4) formal ticket updates + wrap-up demo (Elaine).

elaine: Thanks everyone — please update INF-8421 with any changes. I'll coordinate the customer comms and end-of-day summary. :thumbsup:
